notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Cacophodon indestructible.
description:
Give Cacophodon indestructible by any method.
Activate Acorn Catapult by paying {1} and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Cacophodon and creating a 1/1 Squirrel token.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping Acorn Catapult.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.
